## Today

`app-wear/build.gradle.kts` declares `androidx.compose.material3`,
`androidx.compose.ui` and `androidx.compose.ui.graphics` but no
`androidx.activity:activity-compose`. `app-phone/build.gradle.kts`
declares `implementation(libs.androidx.activity.compose)` in its own
`dependencies {}` block. No `ComponentActivity` or `MainActivity`
exists anywhere under `app-wear/`.

## Expected

`app-wear/build.gradle.kts` declares
`implementation(libs.androidx.activity.compose)` in its `dependencies
{}` block, using the `androidx-activity-compose` alias already
present in `gradle/libs.versions.toml` (version `1.8.0`), so a
`ComponentActivity` can be written in the module.
